If sentiment is negative (≤0.0) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% in early horizon (days 1–7) to align with downward momentum.

If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) and price is trending upward, increase forecast by 1.0–1.5% in mid-horizon (days 8–15) to capture bullish momentum.

If sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67) and forecast diverges >2.0% from true path, apply a 0.5–1.0% downward correction in late horizon (days 16–30) to dampen overconfidence.

If true price drops >3.0% from 30d high within 5 days, reduce forecast by 1.0–2.0% in early horizon to reflect sharp reversal.

If sentiment is consistently positive but price is flat or declining, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% in mid-horizon to avoid overestimating bullish bias.

If forecast exceeds true price by >3.0% in late horizon (days 20–30), apply a 1.0–2.0% downward correction to prevent overfitting to recent highs.
